claim: Complete installed secured-tool execution API coverage and allow/deny conformance for the enumerated matrix.
reproduce: cd libs/prebuilt && uv run python -m langgraph.prebuilt.security.tool_api_verifier --output tool-api-report.json

scope.construction_and_inspection: Inventoried separately; trusted application construction/schema/serialization APIs are not tool-execution entry points.
scope.factory_parameters: Identity-preserving adapters and secured fallbacks/alternatives; no replacement executable supplied by untrusted code.
scope.host_oracle: Synthetic host checks exact authorized subject/request/constraints and absence of local fallback, including activation denial; real kernel activation is tested separately.
limits: Finite API conformance, not a proof for all arguments or arbitrary adapter compositions.
Original unguarded aliases, hostile object mutation, policy semantics and effects inside trusted in-process tools are outside this contract.
No claim of complete confidentiality, concurrency/lifetime correctness, or publication mediation.
